camel_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl CredentialSubmitIntlV2 --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION --SceneCode 1234567890 --MerchantBizId dso932dsjsd22 --OcrArea 0201 --FraudCheck true --DocType 02 --version 2022-08-09 --method POST --force
name: CredentialSubmitIntlV2

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set the value to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string.

The first few characters consist of a custom abbreviation defined by the merchant, the middle part can contain a time segment, and the last part can use a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh:
商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。

其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If you choose this method to submit a photo, check the photo size and do not submit an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择此方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:

01: Transaction voucher, which includes electronic bill images for utilities such as water, electricity, gas, and credit cards.
02: Vehicle registration certificate.
03: Transfer transaction record.
04: Proof of address (POA)
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型：

01：交易凭据（包括：水、电、煤、信用卡等各类电子账单图片）
02：车辆登记证明
03：转账交易流水
04：poa地址证明
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The extraction type. Valid values:
0101: electronic bill address and name module (extracts address and name modules through intelligent analysis).
0201: 
0301: transfer transaction amount information.
0401: POA credential extraction information
parameters.help_zh:
提取类型：
0101：电子账单地址和姓名模块（通过智能分析提取地址及姓名模块）
0201: 
0301：转账交易流水金额信息
0401：poa凭证提取信息
parameters.name: ocr_area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启篡改检测
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: fraud_check

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable quality detection. Valid values: Y (enabled) and N (disabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启质量检测 Y: 开启, N: 关闭
parameters.name: id_quality

parameters.help_en: The field validation rule configuration. The value is a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 字段校验规则配置，JSON字符串
parameters.name: check_rule_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable standardization of key fields recognized by OCR. Valid values:
0: Disabled (default). 
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要开启OCR识别关键字段标准化
0：否 (默认) 
1：是
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable translation. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启翻译 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_translation

parameters.help_en:
The type of the input material. Valid values:

IMAGE (default): image.
PDF: PDF format
parameters.help_zh:
素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：图片
PDF：pdf 格式
parameters.name: file_input_type

parameters.help_en: The custom verification scenario ID. You can use this scenario ID to query related records in the console. The value is a combination of up to 10 letters, digits, or underscores
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合
parameters.name: scene_code

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the verification request
